title: research-queue-dispatch reads 'failure' on every cycle because collect_runner_results.py reports 'lost a run's rows' (pre-existing; seen on every run since at least 16:34Z 2026-10-07) -- find the lost-rows cause, make the collector honest (lost vs could-not-list vs nothing-to-collect), and stop a healthy cycle from paging red
note: [2026-10-08T00:32Z manager] Found by RQ-CADENCE while proving the hourly cadence (dispatch now ~1.5 min, land lock-free). ONE QUESTION: which runs' rows does the collector think it lost, why, and what is the correct verdict? Read scripts/ops/collect_runner_results.py + the 'Collect the runner's results since the last cycle' step logs of runs 37678623741 / the 22:52Z and 23:57Z cycles; distinguish lost (a harness run produced rows that never landed) from could-not-list (API) from nothing-to-collect; fix the verdict and, if rows really are lost, the landing path; a cycle whose fire/stamp/receipt landed must read success. Tier-1 (scripts/ops + workflow step), self-land. Dispatch after the midnight golden fix lands (every PR is red until then). [2026-10-08T20Z lane] ROOT CAUSE (MEASURED from step logs of runs 37821619530 and 37809680002, identical): the single 'lost' run is RQ-20261005-803 run 37283785325, a CANCELLED run (28 min, no run-manifest.json). Its artifact is live (not expired), its E5 producer_failed record (research/results/RQ-20261005-803/37283785325.jsonl), record-inputs.json, logs and sims are ALL already on main. The collector tested 'already on main' via run-manifest.json only, so it re-collected the run every cycle; gh run download refuses to extract over an existing file ('file exists'), and that was reported as 'artifact download failed' = LOST. No rows were lost; NOT the double-landing/verdicts.json cause (PI-20261008-ULTSLAND-0001). FIX (PR claude/rq-collector-verdict): already_landed() also accepts the E5 record; download goes via scratch dir + merge; API failures (artifact listing/download) are 'unreadable' = warning, not lost, not red; lost = expired/unreadable record-inputs/emit refused; read_error (run list failed) still red. Self-test plants all three verdicts. Live dry-run on the branch: lost=0. State landed_unproven until the next research-queue-dispatch cycle after merge reads success. [2026-10-09T03Z readout] OBSERVED after #17174 merged (10-08 ~20:37Z): research-queue-dispatch runs 37850888083 (22:02Z dispatch), 37851510733 (22:08Z schedule) and 37873559942 (02:13Z schedule) all conclusion=success, vs 8 consecutive failures before (12:01Z-18:51Z). NOT verified: the collect step's 'lost=0' line (step not found in the job listing via REST; logs not retrieved) so the row's second clause stays unobserved. Recommend manager closes done on the conclusion clause. Queue health at 02:50Z: queued 137, runnable 59, fired 24h 35, results landed 24h 97, last dispatch 22:03:35Z = 4.8h ago (the 4h bar was missed by 0.8h; idle alarm threshold 12h, not tripped); run 37871817823 (dispatch 01:51Z) was still in progress. [2026-10-09T03Z readout] RQ-20260929-017 (gld_pullback_1d weekly re-run, run 37746276853): e5 verdict 'wiring_only' because the mapper cannot evaluate this rule shape (queue_grade -> needs_review). Applying the unit's own rule to the record's numbers: net_total_r +16.68, win 39.1%, 46 trades over 2016-10-10..2026-10-07 -> net R > 0 with n 46 >= 39 = PASS, CAVEAT: the record's 46 trades is the whole-window total, not a separate OOS split, so 'OOS' is not established; no Tier-3 consequence (PASS keeps the leg; weekly cadence continues). Also: RQ-20261008-900/902/903 have no landed result yet (status queued, no research/results dir) - nothing to read. Fix owed (Tier-1): teach harness_dispatch_result.py the PASS/FAIL n>=39 rule shape or have it emit the OOS split.
